features: 64GB Storage for Everyday Use: Store up to 64GB of documents, photos, videos, music and presentations in one compact USB flash drive. Perfect for students, professionals and everyday digital storage, making file organization simple whether at home, school or the office

Performance for Daily File Transfers: Equipped with a USB 2.0 interface, this pen drive delivers read speeds up to 25MB/s and write speeds up to 10MB/s, allowing you to quickly transfer work files, photos, videos and music between compatible devices

Compatibility & Plug-and-Play Convenience: Compatible with Windows, macOS and Linux operating systems. Works seamlessly with laptops, desktop PCs, smart TVs, car audio systems, projectors and other USB-A enabled devices. No additional software or drivers required

Lightweight, Compact & Easy to Carry: Designed with portability in mind, this compact thumb drive easily fits into your pocket, wallet, backpack or laptop bag, making it ideal for travel, business trips, classrooms and everyday commuting

Everyday Digital Storage: Ideal for storing office documents, school assignments, family photos, HD videos, music libraries and backup files. A practical storage solution for work, study and entertainment, backed by a 3-Year Limited Warranty and dedicated customer support
